_comment: Public example only. Every value is null because this file must never carry real account data. Freshness is evaluated from each provider's or pool's own checked_at, never from a shared timestamp. Every window carries a role: BURST windows supply the utilization signal (stranded capacity), BUDGET windows supply the scarcity signal (conservation pressure), and scarcity outranks utilization. remaining_ratio and reset_at are the facts both readings are derived from; the derived NEAR/MEDIUM/FAR, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW and NONE..CRITICAL labels are never stored here. A legacy snapshot with no role reads short_window as BURST and weekly_window as BUDGET; the generic windows list is the way to describe a provider whose caps are not named that way. remaining_confidence may lower the confidence implied by source, never raise it. A real runtime/RESOURCE_STATE.json is gitignored and must use boolean availability.
